Simple 360 Player v0.2 by HG-ERIK
https://github.com/HG-ERIK/simple360player
Release: https://github.com/HG-ERIK/simple360player/releases/tag/v0.2
Tag commit:5d235c1fd24c098ccc1b2463c1b4265bf2e7844c

This test bundle redistributes the upstream release XEX and runtime fonts
without modification, plus original Blades test videos and test instructions.
It is not a Blades release or a claim of Peer Pressure compatibility.

Simple 360 Player is GPLv3; its full tagged source, external dependency sources,
project files and build scripts are included in Source/Simple360Player-0.2-source.zip.
The same source ZIP is published beside the test USB ZIP for separate download.
Upstream code uses FFmpeg0.7 from FFPlay360, mbedTLS2.16 and Inter fonts.
Licence texts are in Notices; dependency copyright notices and additional
licensing/build details remain in the complete source. Keep these notices.

Rebuild the player using the source README: Xbox360 XDK2.0.21256 and Visual
Studio2010 SP1, build FFmpeg then SimplePlayer.vcxproj (Release|Xbox360).
The tools/build.ps1 script targets the sibling Plex client, so use the player
project specified in README for this executable. A compatible XDK toolchain
is a separate prerequisite and is not included. This package was not rebuilt
with xsdk and contains no changes to Blades.

Both short test videos are self-generated. selected.wmv is byte-identical to
the sample previously confirmed playing in the stock Xbox player. test360.mp4
is an H.264 Constrained Baseline640x360 video with AAC stereo44100Hz audio.
Neither has yet been tested in this player on Peer Pressure. They contain no
reference dashboard footage or third-party music. Logs/settings are created
only when the application is run on the console, and are not bundled.
